subject: Custody model & evidence requested — deployment options for ApexHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@apexhealth.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@apexhealth.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Custody model & evidence requested — deployment options for ApexHealth

Thanks for taking the time today — quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can align the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem).

Call highlights:
- ApexHealth processes PHI for patient matching and requires data residency in us-east-1.
- Primary concern: assurance that PHI is never processed on co‑tenanted compute and keys are customer‑managed.
- Procurement needs: statement of isolation and an evidence package for our security review.

Open clarifying questions:
1) For workloads that process PHI do you require physical single‑tenant hardware (true on‑prem), or would a Dedicated capacity pool with strict tenant isolation satisfy legal/regulatory requirements?
2) Do keys need to reside in your AWS account (BYOK / customer-managed KMS) or is a Redwood-managed KMS with key‑wrap acceptable?
3) Any specific egress/network rules we should model now (IP allowlist, VPC peering, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink)?

Next steps we propose:
- I can share a short evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpts, isolation checklist) + a sample network diagram. Attached: redwood-private-checklist.pdf and network-sample-diagram.png.
- Technical deep dive (30–45m) with Ben (solutions) and Rishi (security) to confirm the CMK flow and tenant boundary. Suggest Wed Nov 25 or Thu Nov 26 — what works for your team?
- If Dedicated meets your needs, we will scope the Dedicated pool and provide an SLA and pricing estimate; if not, we will escalate to our Private deployment team for on‑prem options.

Appreciate a headcount for the deep dive (security, infra, procurement).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-private-checklist.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: network-sample-diagram.png (PNG)]

From: Samir Desai <samir@apexhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@apexhealth.ai>, Matt Lewis <matt@apexhealth.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custody model & evidence requested — deployment options for ApexHealth

Marissa — thanks for the summary. A few answers to your questions and one ask from procurement: 

- Residency: yes, all PHI must remain in us-east-1.
- Keys: we require BYOK; keys managed in our AWS account, with no extractable plaintext keys by any vendor.
- Compute isolation: our legal team wants assurance that PHI workloads are not scheduled on hosts shared with other customers. Dedicated pool with single-tenant hosts looks promising, but we need an attestation describing how isolation is enforced and how scheduling is prevented.
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink is preferred; we will provide a list of egress IPs for allowlisting.

Procurement note: we need the evidence package (SOC2 excerpts + isolation attestation) by Dec 3 to keep our December procurement window. Can you provide a short template for the attestation? Also, if Dedicated cannot provide hardware separation, what additional contract language or controls does Redwood offer?

On the deep dive: Priya (security) and Matt (procurement) will join. Wed Nov 25 at 10am ET works for us.

Thanks,
Samir Desai
Head of Security & Compliance, ApexHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@apexhealth.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@apexhealth.ai>, Matt Lewis <matt@apexhealth.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Custody model & evidence requested — deployment options for ApexHealth

Samir — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming Wed 11/25 10am ET. Below is a concrete set of options and what we can deliver ahead of procurement to meet your Dec 3 evidence deadline.

Options (short):
- Option A — Dedicated (Recommended first pass)
  - Dedicated GPU pool reserved for ApexHealth in us-east-1.
  - Single-tenant host scheduling available for PHI workloads (we can mark a subset of instances as "single-tenant").
  - BYOK: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys in your AWS account via cross-account key policies and enveloping.
  - Deliverables: Isolation attestation template, SOC2 Type II excerpt, network diagram tailored to your VPC peering.

- Option B — Private VPC / Customer-managed control plane
  - Private control plane deployed into your VPC (no shared control plane).
  - Stronger guarantees on metadata separation; intended when legal/regulatory language requires vendor not to access any control-plane data.
  - Typically higher lead time and commercial onboarding.

- Option C — On‑prem (last resort)
  - Full air‑gapped or on‑prem appliance. Heaviest lift; involves a separate engagement.

Actions and owners:
- I will upload a short evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpts + isolation attestation template) to our Drive and share the link by EOD Mon 11/23 — owner: Marissa.
- Technical deep dive Wed 11/25 10am ET — owners: Ben (architecture), Rishi (security).
- Ben to provide a draft isolation attestation and a minimal network diagram we can copy into your procurement packet by Nov 24.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-options-onepager.pdf (short one‑pager you can send to procurement).

If the single‑tenant Dedicated pool meets your legal team's needs, we can produce a short contract addendum attesting to that configuration. If they still require private control plane, we will begin the Private deployment intake immediately after the deep dive.

Thanks — talk Wednesday.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-vpc-options-onepager.pdf (PDF)]

Calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-apex-deep-dive

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Custody model & evidence requested — deployment options for ApexHealth

Quick tech notes ahead of Wed: 
- BYOK: we support AWS KMS CMKs in customer accounts via a recommended cross-account key policy and envelope encryption. We cannot access plaintext keys; only encrypted material is passed to Redwood.
- Dedicated single-tenant: we can reserve hosts for your workloads (no scheduling of other customers on those hosts). We'll include how we enforce scheduler constraints in the attestation.
- Audit logs: we will provide exportable audit logs (requestable retention window) and a read‑only access model for your security team.
- Network: VPC peering + egress IP list works. PrivateLink available for lower blast radius.

I'll bring a short tech slide for the deep dive showing key flow and scheduler isolation.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sched-isolation-diagram.svg (referenced)]
